title: So I carried the boat of incense then at Clongowes
html_source: Clongowes is a Jesuit school outside of Dublin. Stephen Dedalus is carrying the nickel shaving bowl previously used as a device in parody of the catholic mass. It continues in this capacity, now being compared to the “boat of incense” used during mass to replenish the metal censer as it burns low.
